items.title: Brandon Ingram did say, however, that he doesn’t have a target date in mind, and rather that it comes down to “whenever I feel ready” since Ingram “still gotta do some more 5-on-5 and get comfortable on the floor and be comfortable jumping and doing the stuff that I do.”

quote.author: Justin Russo
quote.text: Brandon Ingram told reporters that he’s “coming back soon” and said “I feel good.” Ingram relayed that he’s been “doing some 3-on-3 and 5-on-5 a little bit” as he ramps up. “My body’s feeling good, my heel’s feeling better. We’re getting closer.”
